items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Dicky and Dan Minor are still there in '38... [INTERVIEWEE] Mm hmm.

ctx.x: Yeah. I remember. And then Hunt -- George Hunt left. What happened to George Hunt?
So, it was Dicky and who, Stan?
Dicky and Dan Minor are still there in '38. Then Benny Morton, Dicky, and then Harry Edison takes Bobby Moore's place.
